description: 对话模式探索性实验（conversation-mode exploratory）。使用 Claude Code 桌面应用 Agent tool 直接调用模型，与旧数据和原 CLI 受控实验分开保存。不用于替代 CLI 协议受控结果。
execution_method: Claude Code desktop app Agent tool (model='sonnet' / model='opus')
execution_context: Current conversation (claude-sonnet-4-6) acts as organiser; each prediction session is a separate Agent subagent. Subagents inherit the desktop app's subscription login; tool access available to subagents (documented per session). Context isolation: subagents receive only the prompt file path; no labels, scores, prior predictions, paper content, or audit data are passed.
known_limitations: Agent tool subagents may have tool access (Read, Bash, etc.) — documented but not machine-disabled
No native CLI event log; session identifiers are desktop-app task IDs, not service-native request IDs
Model version confirmed from Agent tool model parameter only; no server-returned model ID available
Subagents may inherit some project context from the desktop app environment
scoring_rule: All 18 session outcomes (success, failure, or not_run) saved and frozen before any scoring. Scoring only for sessions with complete, valid prediction arrays. Partial predictions scored N/A. No re-runs based on scores.
failure_rule: Session with missing, incomplete, or malformed prediction array recorded as failure (N/A score). No manual label correction. No copying results across repeats.
result_labeling: All results labeled 对话模式探索性结果 (conversation-mode exploratory). Not claimed to pass original CLI protocol validation.
